verdict: All 20 acceptance criteria pass against the real files. node _synckcheck.mjs reports ALL CLEAN; package.json/package-lock.json show no diff. git diff -U0 gives 14 hunks in index.html, 12 removed lines total, and every one of them is a line the piece had to remove (BUILD_VERSION, the 7-line duplicated opNiceName map, _ppGenListing's `const base =` and `rarity:` lines, and the city script tag plus the `-->` it had to reopen to extend). Zero reindentation, zero comment loss, git diff --check clean. The bridge key set is exactly the pinned 36 and matches the module's NULL_BRIDGE, which duck-types resources() the way the bridge ships it. Every method is try-wrapped with a typed default; every mutator returns a boolean; refundRes/addRes are both present with the uncapped-undo vs capped-add distinction argued as a safety property; setRigField is key-allow-listed AND value-checks condition against PP_COND_MULT. A non-haul _ppGenListing row is field-for-field identical and the RNG stream is untouched when the module is absent (`RIGS && _ppChance(0.18)` short-circuits). _convoyCanSend, _convoySpend, _convoyGrant, CONVOY_TRUCKS, GARAGE_RIG_FX, GARAGE_RIGS, _jbConvoys, _vmResearchMult, playerOwnsVehicle and worker.js are all outside every hunk. No discord/webhook/wallet_credit/upload text, no new .from(/.rpc(, no raw Profile.gems assignment. The three deploy knobs move together and consistently (v120w7 / v120w7 / mythic-v120w7-transport-wiring). I spot-checked roughly a dozen factual claims in the new comments against the file and they hold: _ppaWin really does take slot from p.lot.length, ppBuyVehicle really does raw-subtract Profile.gems at 196300, the admin photo grid really keys off v.name at 197737, PPA_RARITIES really is a second five-tier ladder, the Mythic roadtrain really is 3.4M at weight 1, there really are 8 push(_ppGenListing()) sites, and the inline label map really did list 14 ops with warehouse and genelab missing.
biggest_gap: Two silent duplications that the file never names an authority for. (1) _transportGrantStarterRig re-derives Prince Portfolios' fair-value formula inline (baseValue x PP_COND_MULT[cond] x max(0.5, 1 - mileage/600000)) instead of calling _ppFairValue() at 196142, and drops that function's Math.max(1000, ...) floor; if the wear curve is ever retuned the starter rig prices itself off a stale copy. (2) _transportOps() re-implements the Operations.list + _jbLocalOpsList() union and dedup that _opsAllRows() (208268) already performs -- the brief even named _opsAllRows as the helper to wire to. Not reusing it is defensible (it calls _opsAdoptOwnedCompanies(), which has a save side effect and cannot help a transport charter), but that reasoning is nowhere in the file, so a repo whose distinguishing habit is recording the rejected option leaves this one unrecorded. Alongside these, one line reference is stale: the lot() comment cites ppBuyVehicle's Object.assign build as ~196022 when it is at 196302, and the same function is cited correctly as ~196289/196294/196299/196301 elsewhere in the same block.
